meta.production_use: descriptive postgame research only; no projection, rating, or wager input
meta.update_policy: Completed games only; independently verified finals; whole-game quarantine for unresolved possession or score context.
meta.sample_warning: Early-season and quarantined-game coverage can be thin. Reliability labels describe sample size; values are not team rankings.
meta.team_scope: All teams in admitted games are retained, including FCS opponents, for FBS-vs-FCS context.
